in_sanskrit.name: वेनुगोपाल
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: वेनु (Venu) - Forest, गोपाल (Gopal) - Protector. Venugopal is a name of Lord Krishna, who is often depicted as the protector of the forest.

in_hindi.name: वेनुगोपाल
in_hindi.long_meaning: वेनु (Venu) - वन (forest), गोपाल (Gopal) - पालनाराज (Lord of protection). Venugopal is a name of Lord Krishna, who is often depicted as the protector of the forest.

in_telugu.name: వెనుగోపాళ
in_telugu.long_meaning: వెను (Venu) - ఫీర్నీ (forest), గోపాళ (Gopal) - శోదరి (protector). Venugopal is a name of Lord Krishna, who is often depicted as the protector of the forest.

in_marathi.name: Venugopal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Forest
in_marathi.long_meaning: Venugopal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Venugopal means 'Lord of the Forest' or 'Lord of the Serene Forest'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Venu' (meaning 'forest') and 'Gopala' (meaning 'protector' or 'caretaker'). In Hindu mythology, Venugopal is an incarnation of Lord Vishnu who is believed to protect and nurture the forests and all the creatures in it. This name is also associated with Lord Krishna who is often depicted as the 'Lord of the Forest'.
